Kūrmapurāṇa
one of the 18 Mahāpurāṇas; imparted by Viṣṇu in his incarnation a. a tortoise to King Indradyumna. According to the Bhāgavata, Vāyu an. Matsya Purāṇas, it contained 17000 or 18000 ślokas; but the extant text has only 6000. According to the ptd. text (I. p. 4, Bib. Ind. edn.), Kū. p.. consisted of four Saṁhitās, Brāhmī, Bhāgavatī, Saurī an. Vaiṣṇavī; an. the available text represents the first only. The Nāradīya p.. (pūrva. 10

) gives the contents of the three other Saṁhitās, their extent being respectively 4000, 2000 an. 5000 granthas. See Wilson, Viṣṇu p.. I. Preface p.. lxxvi-viii. Its date is probably 500-800 A. D. (R. C. Hazra, Puranic Records on Hindu rites an. customs p. 71). On dh. writers who q. it from 1060 A. D. onwards an. its Smṛti chs., see R. C. Hazra, ibid. p.. 66, 71-75.
